scripts.build: pnpm --filter konekt build && pnpm --filter konekt-ui build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter konekt test && pnpm --filter konekt-ui test && pnpm --filter integrations test
scripts.check:packages:built: publint packages/konekt && publint packages/konekt-ui && attw --pack packages/konekt --profile esm-only && attw --pack packages/konekt-ui --profile esm-only --exclude-entrypoints ./styles.css
scripts.check:code: pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm check:node && pnpm check:packages:built && pnpm --filter example build && pnpm --filter showcase build
scripts.push: git remote remove publish 2>/dev/null || true; git remote add publish git@github-personal:lsheva/konekt.git; trap 'git remote remove publish 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT; git push publish HEAD --follow-tags
